newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill rate up at 5.50pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill rate up at 5.50pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills climbed to 5.50 percent from 5.48 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price declined to 98.629 from 98.633 and the minimum price accepted was 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 31.7 million dinars worth of bills, down from 32.5 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on June 11, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
